parts.text: I plan and run flights as a dispatcher, deciding which drone flies along which way and signing off on each flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I use the service to help find which of my drones can get to a job's starting point. I also call off flights when needed, but the policy is that software never chooses a drone or way for us. Running flights is hard because things happen outside our control, batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned, and closures can come into force while drones are already in the air.
